# Always-on agents on Temporal

> A runnable Temporal reference implementation, in Python, of an always-on AI agent: a briefing assistant that schedules work, runs agent turns durably, keeps long-term memory, manages sandbox workspaces, and asks a person for approval. It runs on Claude by default, or on Claude through Amazon Bedrock, or on OpenAI models. It is built with the Temporal Python SDK (`temporalio` 1.36.1), Python 3.12, the Anthropic Python SDK, and the OpenAI Python SDK.

Each entry below names one durable-execution pattern, the Temporal API that implements it, and the file that shows it. The code comments explain the reasoning. Lines tagged `agent(invariant|trade-off|constraint)` state rules that must hold when the code changes.

## Scheduling

- [scheduling.py: schedule_briefing](src/always_on_agents/scheduling.py): Runs work now or later through one path. `Client.start_activity` starts a Standalone Activity, with `start_delay` holding it until it is due, so the application needs no timer table or poller. `ActivityIDReusePolicy.ALLOW_DUPLICATE_FAILED_ONLY` stops a second submission of the same briefing.
- [scheduling.py: set_weekly_briefing_schedule](src/always_on_agents/scheduling.py): A recurring Temporal Schedule. It uses a `ScheduleCalendarSpec` with a `comment` and an IANA time zone, and `ScheduleOverlapPolicy.SKIP`. It is created with `create_schedule` and moved with `ScheduleHandle.update`.
- [workflows/session.py: SessionWorkflow._set_timer](src/always_on_agents/workflows/session.py): The agent's own timer tool. It submits a delayed Standalone Activity that later signals the session Workflow.

## Agent loop and recovery

- [activities/agent.py: run_briefing_turn](src/always_on_agents/activities/agent.py): Coarse integration. One Activity wraps a whole agent turn, so a retry repeats every model and tool call. Heartbeats run in the background.
- [workflows/agent_loop.py: WorkflowAgentLoop](src/always_on_agents/workflows/agent_loop.py): Fine-grained integration. Workflow code runs the loop, and each model call and tool call is its own Activity, so replay reuses results that were already recorded.
- [workflows/briefing.py: ResearchWorkflow](src/always_on_agents/workflows/briefing.py): A Workflow implementing a long-running tool. It returns a job ID at once, and `WorkflowIDConflictPolicy.USE_EXISTING` makes a retried call return the same job.
- [llm.py](src/always_on_agents/llm.py): Model clients for the Claude API and Amazon Bedrock (`AsyncAnthropicBedrockMantle`), selected by `AGENT_MODEL_PROVIDER`. Each uses `max_retries=0`, so Temporal owns retries. Errors become retryable or non-retryable `ApplicationError`, and a rate limit sets `next_retry_delay` from the `retry-after` header.
- [llm_openai.py](src/always_on_agents/llm_openai.py): OpenAI models through the Responses API, with `store=False`. The adapter translates the Claude-format conversation kept in Workflow state to and from Responses API items, and carries encrypted reasoning items between calls.

## Memory consolidation

- [workflows/memory.py: MemoryConsolidationWorkflow](src/always_on_agents/workflows/memory.py): Batches interactions by count or time.
  - Messages arrive by signal-with-start.
  - A saved proposal gives publication its own retry boundary.
  - When retries run out, an operator is asked and the Workflow waits for a signal.
  - Continue-As-New keeps history bounded.
- [store.py: publish_batch](src/always_on_agents/store.py): Publishes in one transaction, with an optimistic base-revision check that raises a non-retryable `StaleBatchError`.
- [app.py: consolidate_now](src/always_on_agents/app.py): A fixed per-user Workflow ID with `WorkflowIDConflictPolicy.FAIL`.

## Workspaces

- [workflows/workspace.py: WorkspacePoolWorkflow](src/always_on_agents/workflows/workspace.py): A hot-pool controller for sandbox VMs.
  - VMs are claimed through a Workflow Update and released by signal.
  - It runs health checks, cleans up orphans, rate-limits VM creation, and uses Continue-As-New.
- [workflows/workspace.py: WorkspaceLeaseWorkflow](src/always_on_agents/workflows/workspace.py): Save-and-release. It saves the files, Temporal records the save, and only then is the VM released.

## Sessions and approvals

- [workflows/session.py: SessionWorkflow](src/always_on_agents/workflows/session.py): One Workflow per chat session.
  - The `send_message` Update returns once a message is accepted, not when the work finishes.
  - An approval binds to the digest of the exact tool parameters and expires at a deadline.
  - Clients reconnect by reading events from an offset with a Query.
- [web/server.py](src/always_on_agents/web/server.py): A FastAPI server that streams session events with Server-Sent Events and resumes from `Last-Event-ID`.

## Testing

- [tests/conftest.py](tests/conftest.py): Tests run against `WorkflowEnvironment.start_local`. `assert_replays` replays each Workflow's history with `Replayer` to catch non-determinism.
- [README.md: Recovery drills](README.md): Fault injection and an operation log show what repeats after a crash and what doesn't.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): The rules for changing this code, and the commands that check a change.
